title: Futuristic HUD lab 2 (source of the round-2 templates)
summary: The 8 comps the round-2 Futuristic HUD templates were built and verified in: ID lower third, segment loader, hex grid, signal bars, target lock, alert banner, map ping and scan wipe.
use_when: You want to see a round-2 HUD template working before using it, copy a comp's objects, or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py.
carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-27
copy_notes: Each comp except FH Scan wipe has a 'Lab bg' rectangle; templates are extracted with --drop "Lab bg".
Clip ids are unique per comp (fid_, fld_, fhx_, fsg_, ftl_, fal_, fmp_, fsw_).
Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/futuristic_hud_lab2.py writes the comps; apply its PRESETS with preset.apply, then edit.save.
Every comp lints 0 errors / 0 warnings; qc at 240 px finds no flashes.
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-27
